programme.title: Ātruma cilts
programme.desc: Raidījums "Ātruma cilts" ar Paulu Timrotu priekšgalā, kā vienmēr, darīs blēņas un brauks ātri ar visu, kas pagadās. Tad jau redzēs, vai tās būs driftmašīnas vai skrituļdēļi, vai varbūt jahtas? Tas atkarīgs no cilvēkiem, kurus satiksim savā ceļā. Tāpat mēs noteikti izmantosim seno tehniku, no laikiem, kad auto bija BEZ ABS, un runāsimies ar cilvēkiem, kas dzīvē ko sasnieguši, pārvietojoties ātri, ekstrēmi un ar adrenalīnu. "Ātruma cilts" ar Paulu Timrotu ir aizraujošs auto un moto raidījums, kas apvieno izklaidi, izglītību un iedvesmu. Tas popularizē aktīvu dzīvesveidu, atklāj jaunos talantus un stāsta par spilgtām personībām. Ātrums, izaicinājumi, unikāli vēsturiski spēkrati un neparasti eksperimenti garantēti.

programme.title: Tāskmāsters
programme.desc: Joku šovs, kurā slaveni britu komiķi veic ārkārtīgi dīvainus uzdevumus un tāskmāsters Gregs Deiviss tos pienācīgi novērtē. Sagadījies tā, ka Grega palīgs Alekss Horns ir apveltīts ne tikai ar bezgalīgu uzticību, bet arī dīvainībām pilnu prātu.

programme.title: Tāskmāsters
programme.desc: Joku šovs, kurā slaveni britu komiķi veic ārkārtīgi dīvainus uzdevumus un tāskmāsters Gregs Deiviss tos pienācīgi novērtē. Sagadījies tā, ka Grega palīgs Alekss Horns ir apveltīts ne tikai ar bezgalīgu uzticību, bet arī dīvainībām pilnu prātu.

programme.title: Divarpus vīri
programme.desc: Divi brāļi nevarētu būt dažādāki - Čārlijam ir viss, ko dzīvē var vēlēties - nauda, skaista māja okeāna piekrastē, pavisam nedaudz darāmā un neskaitāmas draudzenes, turpretī Alans ir īsts neveiksminieks - no viņa ir izšķīrusies sieva, kura ir paturējusi sev abu kopīgi iegādāto māju, un Alans nespēj savilkt kopā galus, lai samaksātu rēķinus. Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

programme.title: Divarpus vīri
programme.desc: Divi brāļi nevarētu būt dažādāki - Čārlijam ir viss, ko dzīvē var vēlēties - nauda, skaista māja okeāna piekrastē, pavisam nedaudz darāmā un neskaitāmas draudzenes, turpretī Alans ir īsts neveiksminieks - no viņa ir izšķīrusies sieva, kura ir paturējusi sev abu kopīgi iegādāto māju, un Alans nespēj savilkt kopā galus, lai samaksātu rēķinus. Tā kā Alanam nav pa kabatai atļauties savu mājokli, viņš lūdz Čārlijam atļauju padzīvot pie viņa kādu laiciņu, kamēr apradīs ar jauno situāciju un atradīs pats savu mājvietu. Viņi pat nenojauta, uz cik ilgu laiku tas ievilksies un cik daudz jautrības tas sagādās skatītājiem.

programme.title: Izdzīvot uz Zemes
programme.desc: Ar jaunāko tehnoloģiju palīdzību sen zudušās pasaules atdzīvojas no jauna, lai rastu atbildi uz jautājumu: kā dzīvība uz Zemes spēja atkal un atkal pielāgoties mainīgajiem vides apstākļiem un pārdzīvot pat vispostošākās masveida izmiršanas epizodes Zemes vēsturē?

programme.title: Izdzīvot uz Zemes
programme.desc: Ar jaunāko tehnoloģiju palīdzību sen zudušās pasaules atdzīvojas no jauna, lai rastu atbildi uz jautājumu: kā dzīvība uz Zemes spēja atkal un atkal pielāgoties mainīgajiem vides apstākļiem un pārdzīvot pat vispostošākās masveida izmiršanas epizodes Zemes vēsturē?

programme.title: Nautilus
programme.desc: Jauns skatījums uz Žila Verna 1870. gada romānu "20 000 ljē pa jūras dzelmi". Nemo ir Indijas princis, kuram liktenis atņēmis gan pirmdzimtā tiesības uz troni, gan ģimeni. Viņa dzīves ceļš no karaļnama greznības ved līdz pat okeāna dziļajai dzelmei. Kļūdams par dumpinieku un ģeniālu zinātnieku, Nemo rada vienu no visiespaidīgākajiem kuģiem pasaules vēsturē - zemūdeni "Nautilus". Taču ne jau tikai zemūdens pasauli viņš vēlas izpētīt. Ar savu uzticamo komandu Nemo uzsāk cīņu pret Austrumindijas tirdzniecības kompāniju - varenu un nežēlīgu organizāciju, kas reiz izpostīja viņa dzīvi. Šis konflikts kļūst par sīvu cīņu starp apspiestajiem un apspiedējiem, starp zinātni un alkatību, starp brīvību un kontroli. Vai Nemo izdosies atriebties saviem ienaidniekiem? Kādi noslēpumi slēpjas okeāna zilajās dzīlēs?

programme.title: Nautilus
programme.desc: Kapteinis Nemo un viņa apkalpe izdomā pārdrošu plānu, kā sagraut Austrumindijas tirdzniecības kompāniju. Izplatot baumas par gaidāmo kompānijas sabrukumu, viņi izraisa strauju akciju cenu kritumu, un tiek sasaukta akcionāru sapulce. Nemo cenšas iegūt kontrolpaketi, lai pilnībā likvidētu uzņēmumu. Operācijas laikā Nemo sastop kapteini Billiju Milaisu, un šī tikšanās noved pie divkaujas. Kad apkalpe mēģina aizbēgt no Londonas, zemūdenei uzbrūk kompānijas spēki.

programme.title: Spiegs
programme.desc: Gudrā, bet kompleksu māktā CIP analītiķe Sjūzena Kūpere (Melisa Makārtija) gadiem ir bijusi nozīmīga spēlētāja veiksmīgā svarīgu operāciju norisē. Kad pazūd viņas pārinieks, Sjūzenai beidzot ir iespēja iejusties slepenās aģentes ādā. Izliekoties par kaķu mīļotāju un ar grūtībām tiekot galā ar tehnoloģijām, Sjūzena cenšas izdzīvot straujajā spiegošanas pasaulē. Vai viņai izdosies īstenot sapni būt par īstu spiedzi un īstenot uzdevumu?

programme.title: Neredzamais cilvēks
programme.desc: Sesīlijai izdodas aizbēgt no vardarbīgā vīra villas, kas laika gaitā bija kļuvusi par viņas cietumu. Ļaunais murgs šķietami ir galā, kad Sesīlija uzzina, ka vīrs pēc viņas aizbēgšanas izdarījis pašnāvību. Taču pēkšņi Sesīlijas dzīvē sāk notikt neizskaidrojami notikumi – pazūd svarīgi dokumenti un viņa ik soļa jūtas novērota. Tuvinieki apšauba Sesīlijas veselo saprātu, tomēr viņai rodas nelāgas aizdomas. Viņas bijušais strādāja pie augsto tehnoloģiju kamuflāžas tērpa, kas valkātāju var padarīt neredzamu. Vai vīrs tiešām ir gatavs uz jebko, lai iznīcinātu viņas dzīvi?

programme.title: Auto mednieki Austrālijā
programme.desc: Austrālijas auto entuziasti un kolekcionāri Džeitī un Deivs apceļo Austrālijas plašumus, lai atrastu retro automašīnas, ko skāris skumjš liktenis, rūsa un laika nepielūdzamais pirksts. Viņi dodas turp, kur citi pat neiedomātos - pa putekļainiem tuksneša bezceļiem, cauri pamestām sētām, iekšā pussabrukušos šķūņos, un nereti tas atmaksājas! Katrs atradums ir loterija - reizēm atrastais auto vraks ir tikai bezcerīgs metāllūznis, citreiz īsts dārgums, ko var atdzīvināt un pārvērst braucošā leģendā. Viņus sagaida vareni atradumi - retais Holden Monaro, jaudīgais Ford Falcon GT, veci Land Rover, Alfa Romeo un pat Volkswagen vabolītes. Vīri riskēs ar savu naudu, nerviem un laiku, lai tās atjaunotu, jo nekad nevar zināt, vai atrasto autiņu dzinējs vēl kādreiz rūks.

programme.title: The Answer Man
programme.desc: Everyone wants to meet Arlen Faber (Jeff Daniels), the world-famous author of the best-selling spiritual book ''Me and God'', but crotchety, disgruntled Arlen simply wants to be left alone, and so far he's been successful at keeping his identity a secret. But all that changes when troubled bookstore owner Kris Lucas (Lou Taylor Pucci) discovers his home address and barters books for Arlen's words of wisdom, and a back injury leads the reclusive writer to date chiropractor and overprotective single mother Elizabeth (Lauren Graham). As Arlen's relationships with his newfound friends grow, he must come to terms with his past and the realization that he doesn't hold all the answers.

programme.title: When Pigs Have Wings
programme.desc: After a tempest, fishermen do not find only fish in their nets. That is what happens to Jafaar, a poor fisherman who lives poorly in Gaza. And what he hauls in is really upsetting : imagine that, a pig! An unclean animal judged impure not only by the Faith of Islam but also by the Jewish religion. Determined to get rid of the animal, Jafaar tries desperately to sell it, first to a United Nations official, then to a Jewish colony where Yelena raises pigs not for their meat but for security reasons. Of course, going unnoticed in the company of a "forbidden" animal, among his Palestinian brothers, past Israeli soldiers and under the scrutiny of Islamic fundamentalists is no bed of roses and a series of misadventures await Jafaar....

programme.title: Eye of the Storm
programme.desc: Isabelle Gagnon, a single mother of three, shows that custody can be shared, but it's not without struggle. She will have to weather the storm in order to find new friendship and new love.

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere.

programme.title: Days of the Bagnold Summer
programme.desc: Coming-of-age comedy starring Earl Cave (son of singer Nick) as a heavy-metal-loving teenager who is forced to spend the summer with his boring old mum, in Simon Bird's (The Inbetweeners) debut feature in the director's chair. Daniel (Cave) is all set for six weeks in Florida with his dad and his dad's pregnant wife, Bernie. The weather will be fantastic, and he'll get to drive his father's MG convertible. Meanwhile, his mum (Monica Dolan) won't let him drive the Vauxhall Astra and she never gets her own cake, but instead nicks bits of his. So, when Bernie calls to say that Daniel won't be able to come to Florida, Daniel is obviously not very happy. Can a Metallica-loving, black-clad teenager with Tippexed emblems on his shoes have any fun with a middle-aged librarian who wears comfortable sandals? Well, she is his mum... Also starring Tamsin Greig and Rob Brydon. Network Premiere.

programme.title: The Magic of Belle Isle
programme.desc: Monte Wildhorn (Freeman) is a famous Western (genre) novelist. His struggle to cope with the death of his wife six years earlier has sapped his passion for writing and has caused him to begin drinking heavily. He takes a lakeside cabin for the summer in picturesque Belle Isle and befriends the family next door—an attractive single mother (Madsen) and her young daughters—who help him find inspiration again.

programme.title: Is Anybody There?
programme.desc: In 1987 Edward (Bill Milner) is a ten-year-old boy who lives at an old people's home run by his parents (David Morrissey and Anne-Marie Duff). Surrounded by death and dying, he becomes obsessed with finding evidence for the afterlife, often using a tape recorder to capture his "encounters". He is helped in his search by Clarence (Michael Caine), an elderly ex-magician in the early stages of dementia who has recently entered the home. The film follows their quest and their friendship, which ultimately allows both Edward and Clarence to come to terms with their respective situations.

programme.title: Nightcap
programme.desc: In Lausanne, the aspirant pianist Jeanne Pollet has lunch with her mother Louise Pollet, her boyfriend Axel and his mother. Lenna leans that when she was born, a nurse had mistakenly told to the prominent pianist André Polonski that she would be his daughter. André has just remarried his first wife, the heiress of a Swiss chocolate factory Marie-Claire "Mika" Muller and they live in Lausanne with André's son Guillaume Polonski. Out of the blue, Jeanne visits André and he offers to give piano classes to help her in her examination. Jeanne becomes closer to André and sooner she discovers that Mika might be drugging her stepson with Rohypnol. Further, she might have killed his second wife Lisbeth.

programme.title: Nostalgia
programme.desc: A man returns to his hometown of Naples, 40 years after abruptly leaving as a teen, stirring up a past which he's kept buried. He is determined to see his boyhood friend, now a leading Naples crime boss, with whom he shares a dark secret. Italian with English subtitles

programme.title: The Lavender Hill Mob
programme.desc: Classic Ealing comedy from director Charles Crichton. Alec Guinness stars as a mild-mannered transporter of gold bullion. He has been doing the job for the past 20 years honestly enough, but suddenly decides to steal a million pounds. He enlists the help of paperweight manufacturer Stanley Holloway and the men hijack the bank's armoured car. Once in their hands, the gold bars are melted down and formed into small, souvenir Eiffel Towers. But after the booty is smuggled out to Paris, it is purchased by a group of English schoolgirls. As a result of their pleading with the girls, the gang retrieve all but one of the towers. But the last one is in the hands of a very determined student, and she refuses to part with it... With Sid James, Alfie Bass and Majorie Fielding.

programme.title: Sol
programme.desc: Sol, a famous Argentine Tango performer, has lived in Buenos Aires for many years. Behind her excessive temper and her glowing smile, the Diva hides an injury from which she never really recovered: the loss of her only son, Raphaël.

programme.title: All Our Desires
programme.desc: Moved by the plight of the mother of her daughter's school friend, a young judge facing an incurable disease teams up with an older colleague in order to fight against financial companies that exploit the poor.

programme.title: The Unknown Country
programme.desc: Vids reviewed: * The Matrix * Manumission the movie * Another day in paradise * The guide to G spots and multiple orgasms * The six million dollar man * The bionic woman * Human traffic * Jeremy Clarksons Head to head Nige tells us that the car is the modern Black Death. And the guys pay tribute to police squad by doing the freeze frame sketch over the end credits.

programme.title: Ramen Shop
programme.desc: Masato is a young ramen chef in the city of Takasaki in Japan. After the sudden death of his emotionally distant father, he chances upon a suitcase of memorabilia and a red notebook - filled with musings and old photos - left behind by his Singaporean mother who passed when he was just ten years old. Acting on a hunch, he takes off for Singapore with the notebook, hoping to piece together the story of his life, as well as that of his parents. There he meets Miki, a Japanese food blogger and single mother who helps him track down his maternal uncle Ah Wee, who runs a bak kut teh stall. Masato discovers that his grandmother Madam Lee is still alive, and that she holds the key to the tender yet turbulent love story of his parents. Masato and his grandmother try to heal each other's broken soul, and find salvation in the kitchen where the meals they cook become more than the sum of their ingredients.

programme.title: Chinese Puzzle
programme.desc: Ten years have passed, and the once happy lovers, Xavier Rousseau (Romain Duris) and Wendy (Kelly Reilly), have split. When she moves with their two children to New York City, he also moves to there to be near the children. Wendy now lives with John (Peter Hermann (actor)) in a luxury apartment overlooking Central Park. Xavier initially stays with Isabelle (Cécile de France) and Ju (Sandrine Holt), a lesbian couple whose child he fathered, but he soon finds his own apartment above a Chinese bakery where he works on a new novel assisted by brief visions of Arthur Schopenhauer and Georg Wilhelm Friedrich Hegel.

programme.title: Enduring Love
programme.desc: Roger Michell's drama, based on Ian McEwan's novel, of unrequited love stars Daniel Craig as Joe, out with his girlfriend Claire (Samantha Morton) for a picnic in the countryside. Suddenly, over the trees, appears a hot-air balloon that lands, tipping out the pilot, and then rises again, leaving a young boy stranded in the basket. Joe and other bystanders grab the trailing ropes but, one by one, they are forced to let go as the balloon ascends, except for one person who is borne aloft, before falling to his fate. Joe and Jed (Rhys Ifans) find his body. For Claire and Joe, life returns to a semblance of normality, until Joe starts running into Jed - again and again. And as Jed's obsession grows, so does the danger to Joe and Claire.

programme.title: Sorry Angel
programme.desc: 1993. Jacques (Pierre Deladonchamps) is a 39-year-old gay author living and working in Paris. He is a part-time, albeit inattentive, father to his young son Loulou, who stays with him every other night. Loulou is accustomed to his father's bouts of self-indulgent melancholy as well as his manic appreciation for the arts and his string of young lovers. At the same time, Jacques is in the process of coming to terms with his health's steady decline due to AIDS, which is simultaneously and severely affecting his ex-lover Marco. When Marco is rejected by his lover Thierry and comes to stay with Jacques, the two discuss again their intentions to commit suicide before they can be claimed by the disease. Jacques lives on the floor below his good friend Mathieu (Denis Podalydès), an older gay man and newspaper editor who regular caters to Jacques' flamboyant episodes.

programme.title: My Heart Can't Beat Unless You Tell It To
programme.desc: Writer and director Jonathan Cuartas twists the traditional vampire horror trope into a gritty kitchen-sink drama. Two older siblings look after their younger brother, who's a vampire, by killing to source blood for him. Forget capes. Forget beautiful familiars and neck biting. Forget huge castles nestled precariously on cliffs in some godforsaken forest. This is vampirism John Osborne style. Three siblings live together in a claustrophobic suburban house with an interior the colour of a well-used tea pot. In the opening scene, the eldest, Dwight (Patrick Fugit), kills a homeless man and takes him back to the house where he and his sister Jessie (Ingrid Sophie Schram) drain the corpse into a corrugated metal bin with a tap. They then decant the blood into the bowl and take it to their ailing younger brother Thomas (Owen Campbell), who's apparently catatonic in bed. As he drinks the claret, Thomas revives. And so it goes on. Jessie works as a waiter in a diner and lets Dwight know if she spots a potential kill. Dwight is at the end of his tether and doesn't want to do this anymore. But Jessie reminds him that it's for their little brother. Teenage Thomas hears other kids playing outside and naturally wants to join them. But how can they break the cycle without breaking their family? Network Premiere.

programme.title: Iris
programme.desc: When the young Iris Murdoch meets fellow student John Bayley at Somerville College, Oxford, he is a naive virgin easily flummoxed by her libertine spirit, arch personality, and obvious artistic talent. Decades later, little has changed and the couple keeps house, with John doting on his more famous wife. When Iris begins experiencing forgetfulness and dementia, however, the devoted John struggles with hopelessness and frustration, and becomes her caretaker, as his wife's mind deteriorates from the ravages of Alzheimer's disease.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: The Decoy Bride
programme.desc: Famous actress Lara Tyler can't get married to author James Arber without intrusive paparazzi crashing the ceremony. Because of James's best-seller, Lara's agent, Steve, checks out the little known Hegg Island in Scotland as the site for their next attempted wedding. Unfortunately, James is a hack, and his book (supposedly based on Hegg) relays little of it accurately. Katie, an island native and the only unmarried woman on it, has been unlucky in love. She's working on writing her own guide to Hegg Island when Steve and crew arrive, eventually hiring her as a reluctant decoy bride to distract the paparazzi. In a mix-up, she and James end up married to each other while Lara, having spotted the press, goes into hiding. Katie and James now have to get an island divorce while avoiding the press while other parties seek out Lara (who has disguised herself as one of the elderly islanders).

programme.title: The Summer We Live
programme.desc: Year 1998. Isabel, a journalism student, is forced to do her internship in the newspaper of a small Galician coastal town in order to finish her degree. When she arrives, she wants to start investigating as soon as possible, to demonstrate everything she has learned in order to become a real journalist. But the position she is assigned is the last one she expected: the writing and management of the obituaries that reach the newsroom. But this, which might seem boring at first, becomes the door to an investigation that will take her through different parts of the Spanish geography in search of an impossible love story.

programme.title: My Friend from the Park
programme.desc: Liz, a new mother, meets Rosa and they end up becoming good friends. However, their friendship takes an unexpected turn as Liz is pulled into a life of crime and instability.

programme.title: The Graduate
programme.desc: Classic Oscar-winning comedy drama. Disillusioned graduate Benjamin Braddock is urged by his family to enter a business career and settle down after college, but instead he finds himself seduced by Mrs Robinson, a friend of his parents. He tries to extricate himself from the affair when he falls in love with Mrs Robinson's daughter, but finds that his own actions may have sealed his fate. Featuring the music of Simon and Garfunkel.

programme.title: Girl with a Pearl Earring
programme.desc: Screen adaptation of Tracy Chevalier's best-selling novel, inspired by the Johannes Vermeer painting of the same name. Set in mid-17th-century Delft, Holland, 17-year-old Griet is forced into servanthood when her father suffers an accident and becomes unable to work. She is taken on at the Vermeer household, where her presence immediately provokes hostility from members of the family - particularly the artist's wife and eldest daughter - when she starts to forge an understanding with her mysterious master.

programme.title: Neem Me Mee
programme.desc: Six people over seventy are at a turning point in their lives. Without knowing each other, they go on a journey together.

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Only You
programme.desc: On the eve of her wedding, a young woman meets the love of her life. They decide to spend the whole night together.

programme.title: The Young Lovers
programme.desc: Elegant, retired architect Shauna (70) crosses paths with Pierre, a happily married doctor in his 40s, who first made an impression on her in a brief meeting 15 years previously. Both are quite troubled to meet again and begin an affair. While Pierre's family life is soon turned upside down, Shauna struggles with feelings she thought belonged to the past.

programme.title: Ratcatcher
programme.desc: The film opens focused upon James' friend Ryan Quinn, who is being forced to put on his wellington boots to go to visit his father, who is in jail. But Ryan chose to play with James instead, and runs off while his mother is not looking. Ryan meets James at the canal and during some rough-house play he is drowned, clearly with James bearing much of the blame for not having raised the alarm. James believes his inaction has gone unnoticed.

programme.title: A Girl Missing
programme.desc: A home-care nurse's relationship with the family she has spent years working for is threatened when her nephew is arrested for kidnapping their daughter.

programme.title: Summer White
programme.desc: Rodrigo is a solitary teenager, a king in the private world he shares with his mother. Things change when she takes her new boyfriend home to live. He must decide if he fights for his throne and crushes the happiness of the person he loves the most.

programme.title: The Hypnotist
programme.desc: Swedish thriller based on the best-selling novels of Lars Kepler. When a man and his family are found brutally murdered in a suburb outside Stockholm, Detective Inspector Joona Linna tries to persuade a doctor, Erik Maria Bark, to hypnotise a traumatised witness. But it has been ten years since Erik last practised hypnosis, and he has promised never to do it again. When he finally agrees, a chain of terrifying events starts.

programme.title: Археология
programme.desc: Диалоги о вечных вопросах российской жизни и болевых точках повседневности, о войне и мире. Эти темы Сергей Медведев и его гости обсуждают в программе "Археология".

programme.title: Ждем в гости
programme.desc: Это уникальный кулинарно-этнографический телепроект. Ведущий программы путешествует по удивительно красивым и интересным местам, посещая местные достопримечательности, любуясь природой и знакомясь с новыми людьми. Везде гостеприимные хозяева говорят нашим телезрителям: "Ждем в гости!" Вместе с Зурабом Двали вы побываете в разных уголках прекрасной Грузии. В аджарском кафе "Привет из Батума" вам раскроют секрет фирменного салата заведения, директор батумского отеля "Президент-плаза" научит вас готовить осетрину, в самом центре Тбилиси вы узнаете рецепты приготовления традиционных блюд грузинской кухни, в одном из узбекских ресторанов столицы вас посвятят в тайны узбекской кухни, вы побываете на празднике урожая Тбилисоба, винном заводе №1, на даче знаменитой грузинской певицы Ирмы Сохадзе, в Мцхете и Кахетии...

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Перекрёсток
programme.desc: Сериал, состоящий из короткометражных документальных фильмов, посвященных сложным темам в странах Восточной Европы и Ближнего Востока. Это aвторский взгляд на проблемы и перспективы этих регионов. Настоящая жизнь крупным планом.

programme.title: Спецпроект.док
programme.desc: Цикл документальных программ телеканала "Настоящее Время".

programme.title: Документальный час. Америка
programme.desc: Подборка документальных проектов от "Голоса Америки" — о людях, идеях и событиях, которые формируют наше время. Вечные вопросы и острые темы, глубинные конфликты и неожиданные открытия — каждый выпуск предлагает взгляд на мир через призму человеческих историй.

programme.title: Реальное кино
programme.desc: Документальный фильм показывает зарубежное наследие Мариуполя, Лисичанска, Дружковки и Нью-Йорка. Съемочная группа обнаружила и оживила уникальные, но малоизвестные архивные материалы Донбасса XIX века. Эксперты, историки и местные жители делятся своими рассказами и свидетельствами об истории региона, которая была тщательно уничтожена и искажена советскими властями. Вскоре после съемок почти все локации были уничтожены российскими ракетами.

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Балтийский путь
programme.desc: Это фильмы о людях, живущих в Латвии, Литве и Эстонии. Они говорят на разных языках, но все — об одном и том же: о том, что волнует, огорчает или радует каждого из нас. Мы не делим жизнь на политику и всё остальное — мы просто говорим о самом важном.

programme.desc: Необычные истории из повседневной жизни

programme.title: Америка. Большое путешествие
programme.desc: Документальный проект рассказывает о разных американских штатах и городах через истории их жителей, культуру и кухню. Авторы приглашают зрителей за кулисы известных туристских центров и знакомят их с людьми, которые представляют собой коллективный портрет американского общества и демонстрируют лучшие качества американского характера: целеустремленность, инициативность, самодостаточность. Особое внимание в каждом эпизоде будет уделяться предпринимателям, сильным и независимым женщинам, успешным эмигрантам и представителям меньшинств.

programme.title: Смотри в оба
programme.desc: Проект о новостях и тех, кто эти новости делает. О фейках и сенсациях, о невольных ошибках и сознательных манипуляциях. Мы ищем информацию из разных источников, сравниваем и представляем на ваш суд.

programme.desc: Передача "Искусство в деталях" глубоко исследует международную креативную сцену, раскрывая новые идеи и объясняя культурные феномены, которые формируют нашу историю, настоящее и будущее. Кто такие современные художники? Какие произведения стали их визитной карточкой? Какое влияние они оказывают на общество? И где можно познакомиться с их яркими проектами?

programme.title: Реальное кино
programme.desc: Документальный фильм показывает зарубежное наследие Мариуполя, Лисичанска, Дружковки и Нью-Йорка. Съемочная группа обнаружила и оживила уникальные, но малоизвестные архивные материалы Донбасса XIX века. Эксперты, историки и местные жители делятся своими рассказами и свидетельствами об истории региона, которая была тщательно уничтожена и искажена советскими властями. Вскоре после съемок почти все локации были уничтожены российскими ракетами.
